text:
Anya (PM): Quick sync  Prioritization decision: eval-triggered alerts vs quant recommendations. Customers pressing for alerting.

Sam (Eng): Alerts feel urgent but touch infra (ingest, rules, webhooks). Quant recs are lower risk to pilot offline.

Maria (ML Eng): Alerts need good eval signals or we'll create noise. We should require baseline eval sets per customer and smoothing (EWMA).

Toby (CS): AcmeHealth and BetaCorp asked for auto-alerts. They want <3% drop detection and a rollback playbook.

Anya (PM): Proposed MVP (this sprint): scoped eval-triggered alerts for text-gen models, single region, 1 pilot customer. Acceptance criteria:
- detect regression within 15m of eval ingest
- console alert + email + webhook created
- FPR <= 10% on holdout
- documented rollback playbook

Sam (Eng): Rough infra tasks:
- collector pipeline (kinesis->eval svc) 3d
- rules engine + webhook 4d
- console feed + perms 3d
- canary routing + rate limits 2d
Total ~12 dev days for scoped MVP.

Maria (ML Eng): I'll produce baseline eval scripts and thresholds in ~5d; need ~500 eval samples/customer for stable thresholds.

Toby (CS): Pilot rollout: dogfood 1w, AcmeHealth pilot w/ manual ack 2w, then ramp to 5 customers. I can draft comms and the incident template.

Anya (PM): UI minimal: alert table with model/version, metric, delta; actions: ack, mute, trigger rollback; link to failing examples.

Sam (Eng): Ops constraints: ingestion SLA to meet 15m detection. Add circuit-breaker to avoid alert storms and webhook retry throttling. Rollback should be permission-gated and testable.

Maria (ML Eng): Target detection sensitivity >70% on historical regressions, specificity keep FPR <10%. Tune per-customer if needed.

Anya (PM): Quant recommendations plan: run offline during alerts pilot and surface as "beta recs" later. Lower risk, gives data.

Anya (PM): Action items: @Sam write infra RFC + task list (EOD Fri), @Maria baseline scripts + thresholds (Wed), @Toby customer playbook + comms (Thu). I'll own rollout docs & acceptance.

ops-bot: Reminder  create channel #pilot-acme-alerts when pilot starts.

Sam (Eng): Posting RFC to #eng-runtime and will link here.

Toby (CS): Scheduling weekly check-ins with AcmeHealth.

Maria (ML Eng): Starting eval prep now, will post updates.

Anya (PM): Locking ticket and updating roadmap. :white_check_mark:
